mapper.insert: insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen(run_id,source_id,business_key,source_updated_at,source_hash) values(#{runId},#{sourceId},#{businessKey},#{updatedAt},#{hash}) on conflict(run_id,source_id) do update set source_updated_at=excluded.source_updated_at, source_hash=excluded.source_hash,observed_at=clock_timestamp()

insert into integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff(run_id,business_key,source_id,difference_type, source_updated_at,target_updated_at,source_hash,target_hash,repaired,verification_status,repair_status,detail) values(#{runId},#{businessKey},#{sourceId},#{differenceType},#{sourceUpdatedAt},#{targetUpdatedAt}, #{sourceHash},#{targetHash},false,'OBSERVED','NOT_REQUESTED',#{detail}) on conflict(run_id,business_key) do nothing
mapper.update: update integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff set difference_type=#{differenceType}, source_updated_at=#{sourceUpdatedAt},target_updated_at=#{targetUpdatedAt}, source_hash=#{sourceHash},target_hash=#{targetHash},verification_status=#{verificationStatus}, repair_status=#{repairStatus},repaired=#{repaired},detail=#{detail}, verified_at=clock_timestamp(), repaired_at=case when #{repaired} then clock_timestamp() else repaired_at end where id=#{id} and run_id=#{runId}
mapper.select: select min(d.verified_at) from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff d join integration_schema.job_run r on r.run_id=d.run_id where r.job_code=#{jobCode} and d.source_id=#{sourceId} and d.difference_type='MISSING_SOURCE' and d.verification_status in ('OBSERVED','CONFIRMED') and d.verified_at>coalesce(( select max(s.observed_at) from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen s join integration_schema.job_run seen_run on seen_run.run_id=s.run_id where seen_run.job_code=#{jobCode} and s.source_id=#{sourceId} ),to_timestamp(0))

select distinct d.source_id from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff d join integration_schema.job_run r on r.run_id=d.run_id where r.job_code=#{jobCode} and d.difference_type='MISSING_SOURCE' and d.verification_status in ('OBSERVED','CONFIRMED') and d.verified_at is not null and d.source_id in #{id}

select t.source_id from integration_schema.cost_center integration_schema.exchange_rate t where t.source_system='SAP' and t.source_id>#{afterId} and t.source_id<=#{maxId} and not exists(select 1 from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_seen s where s.run_id=#{runId} and s.source_id=t.source_id) order by t.source_id limit #{limit}
select * from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} and id>#{afterId} and verification_status='OBSERVED' order by id limit #{limit}
select count(*) from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} and repaired=false and verification_status<>'RESOLVED_BY_RECHECK'
select * from integration_schema.sync_reconciliation_diff where run_id=#{runId} order by id limit 100
